question: How is the constant washing of the mouth symbolically characterized in relation to Brahman?
premises: Washing of the mouth is performed always.
This act is related to Brahman.
It is described as having gone upward.
inference: The constant washing of the mouth is characterized as an upward movement related to Brahman.
uncertainties: The symbolic meaning of 'gone upward to Brahman' is open to interpretation.
plain_english: O beloved, the constant washing of the mouth is that which has gone upward to Brahman.
